subject: health

masteryInterpretation.secure: At least 85% with accurate independent application and adequate evidence and reasoning.
masteryInterpretation.developing: 70–84% or inconsistent explanation; assign targeted review and a fresh transfer check on a later occasion.
masteryInterpretation.not_yet: Below 70% or a missing prerequisite; reteach the smallest gap and reassess with new evidence.
masteryInterpretation.rule: A unit score is one evidence source on one occasion, not the sole basis for long-term mastery.

accommodationNote: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. No assessment requires disclosure, a recording, or any body measurement.

guardianSafetyReview.equipment: None for the proposal. Any real execution requires separate guardian approval.
guardianSafetyReview.environment: Indoor study space; any community component is guardian-planned and supervised.
guardianSafetyReview.sensitive_content_note: Execution beyond the proposal is optional and must be approved and supervised by the guardian, who also decides whether anything is shared outside the household.
